title: MongoDB HTTP interface disclosed
description: The response is the MongoDB native-port HTTP reply: the message about accessing MongoDB over HTTP on the driver port identifies a port that speaks the MongoDB wire protocol rather than HTTP. The reply is what the server returns to an HTTP request on that port.
remediation: Bind MongoDB to a private interface, enable authentication and role-based access, and never publish the driver port on an application ingress.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the port reply; it does not speak the wire protocol and cannot show whether authentication is enforced.
